ASHFALL.name: Ashfall
ASHFALL.text: Ash-blackened highland scored by old eruptions: broken ground, thin scrub, and the ruins the hold takes its name from.

MARSH.name: Marsh
MARSH.text: Low wet ground threaded by slow water: reed flats, sucking mud, and a river that never quite finds a bank.

HIGHLAND_PASS.name: Highland Pass
HIGHLAND_PASS.text: A narrow shoulder of mountain country: steep ranges either side of the only ground an army can cross.
